description: DRAFT (M0). A band/artist profile, published by the band's own account. Doubles as link-in-bio / press-kit-lite. Unclaimed directory entries are NOT records: they live in TBA's database using the same shape.

main.description: The band's TBA profile. One per account.

genres.description: Genre names from TBA's genre vocabulary, exactly as written there (lowercase), e.g. 'atmospheric black metal'. Consumers should ignore values not in the vocabulary (TBA's indexer does). Feeds filter on these.

origin.description: Where the band is from, human-readable, e.g. 'Bergen, Norway'.

bookingContact.description: Public booking contact (email or URL). Optional; the band decides whether to publish it.

externalIds.description: The band's ids in other catalogues, used to match its seeded directory entry.
